source: Retained professional preview proposal in assets/provenance.json
rules: Render committed contextual rasters. Do not redraw, invert, clip, or add a background plaque. Preserve template hero/layout/artwork.

restoration.pipeline: image-generation-assisted transparent PNG master -> Sharp WebP (quality 92, alpha quality 100)
restoration.sourceArchiveNote: The accepted transparent Image Gen artwork existed only as WebP in the previous pass; transparent PNG masters were restored from those accepted pixels before final WebP encoding.

palettePolicy: Preserve template UI palettes; logo artwork retains graphite/gold on light and white/gold on dark or accent surfaces.

surfaceBindings.onLight: graphite and gold on light backgrounds
surfaceBindings.onDark: white and gold on dark backgrounds
surfaceBindings.onAccent: retained white and gold artwork on colored backgrounds
